title: Surprising Japan: A Year of Festivals, Customs, and Unwritten Rules
description: One year of Japanese home life, month by month — the festivals everyone knows, and the small unwritten rules nobody explains. Covers New Year and Hatsumode, Setsubun, Hinamatsuri, Hanami, Children's Day, the rainy season, Tanabata, Obon, moon viewing, sports day, Shichi-Go-San, and Christmas and New Year's Eve in Japan. Plain English, fully illustrated. PDF ebook, 37 pages.

title: Winter in Japan: A Field Guide to the Cold Season
description: Japan's cold season from inside a Japanese home — Christmas fried chicken, the 108 New Year's Eve bells, New Year foods and first shrine visits, and the demon you throw beans at in February. The winter chapters (December, January, February) of Surprising Japan, in one place. Plain English, illustrated. PDF, 15 pages.
